## About Me

I am an MBA student in Canada dedicated to bridging the gap between data science and supply chain excellence. With a background in backend systems and business operations, I thrive on turning raw data into competitive advantages.

My expertise lies in SQL, Python, and predictive analytics, with a current focus on how AI applications can revolutionize business strategy. I'm passionate about building smarter, more resilient supply chains through data-driven decision-making.
